title: Max profit, max loss and POP include round-trip charges in ours (G-13-3)
reference_behaviour: Max profit, max loss, POP and the curves leave charges out; charges are shown in a separate panel.
ours: Curves are before charges (ADR-167), but the max profit and max loss sentences and POP include round-trip charges. Money exception (c), decided by ADR-082 and kept by ADR-167 (3).
